status_vocabulary.COMPLETE: all material requirements satisfied by applicable evidence (a narrow substitute never completes a broader task)
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: implemented portion identified; every material outstanding requirement listed
status_vocabulary.UNBUILT: absent from the integrated release (local preview identified separately)
status_vocabulary.CANCELED: only an entire task explicitly canceled by the owner (none: the backup cancellation is a sub-requirement of INT-09/INT-12)

basis_legend.AB: automated behavioral evidence (browser journeys, tests, gate runs)

scope_legend.enabled workstream; this requirement def: workstream enabled but this requirement is deferred (authentication, multi-tenancy, metrics, load)
scope_legend.deferred: CTL/RES/RND, full RIV/ACT, VAL pilot, accounts, billing

totals_selected_first_release_deliverabl.definition: tasks whose current scope is enabled or enabled-minimal (requirements deferred inside enabled workstreams excluded)

effort_weighting: NOT AVAILABLE — the backlog carries no workload estimates; the counts above are task counts with their denominators, not effort percentages
distinctions: Statuses rest on code inspection and automated behavioral evidence only unless the basis column says otherwise. No human review, prospective study, public release or paid-user validation has occurred; none substitutes for another. Implemented ≠ independently evaluated ≠ pilot-enabled ≠ publicly released.
